svg.text: Discovery: how booking works without a product
A map of the current process. Three sides, five steps, six points of loss.
Looks up the number in search, social
Calls; the line is busy or nobody
Memorises the time and terms by ear
Arrives hoping the table is there
Answers between guests on the floor
Keeps the floor plan in their head
Writes a line in a paper notebook
Looks the record up and checks it by
No idea how many people never got
Cannot see which tables are promised
The data never reaches a system
Learns about a no-show after the fact
Two or three attempts to get through
No confirmation, just a spoken promise
The logbook does not survive a shift change
The restaurant cannot see the demand
Booking breaks not when the restaurant is chosen but at confirmation: the guest leaves without a guarantee, the restaurant without data.
